name: manga-reader
title: Manga Reader
description: A webtoon-style chapter reader made only with mangacn: a series header with a cover drawn in SVG, a Chapters button opening a Sheet with the chapter list (the current chapter is an ink flat, read chapters carry a brush check), a reading-order switch of pressed buttons (Manga RTL / Western LTR) that sets data-reading on the root and flips the previous / next chapter buttons, a ReadingProgress bar with a "Page 3 / 9" counter fed by the strip, a ReaderStrip of nine drawn pages (lazy images, END panel), previous / next chapter buttons and a comments strip (Message, Bubble, ReactionPicker, Input). From @md/main up, on screens at least 36rem tall, the reader fills a 46rem frame that scrolls inside and the progress bar sticks to the top of the frame and measures it; on phones it follows the page and the progress bar sticks to the bottom edge. Works in light, dark, any accent and at phone width.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/manga-reader". The pages are SVG drawings made for the demo: replace chapterPages() with your own scans ({ src, alt, width, height }) and CHAPTERS with your chapter list. The reading order lives in the reader (data-reading on its root).

meta.tagline: A vertical strip, chapters in a sheet, progress and reading order.
